name: 30-Day Push-ups
description: A 30-day push-up challenge with friends: log reps with one big button, keep the streak, watch the leaderboard.
schema: CREATE TABLE friends (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), n INTEGER NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, art TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '/img/a_you.png', color TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '#F2552C', me INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

INSERT INTO friends (id, n, name, art, color, me) VALUES ('f1',1,'You','/img/a_you.png','#F2552C',1),('f2',2,'Mia','/img/a_mia.png','#EC4899',0),('f3',3,'Leo','/img/a_leo.png','#3B82F6',0),('f4',4,'Zoe','/img/a_zoe.png','#14B8A6',0),('f5',5,'Sam','/img/a_sam.png','#F59E0B',0)
CREATE TABLE logs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(8)))), who TEXT NOT NULL, n INTEGER NOT NULL, created TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')))

INSERT INTO logs (who, n, created) VALUES ('Mia',20,datetime('now','-50 minutes')),('Mia',20,datetime('now','-40 minutes')),('Leo',35,datetime('now','-30 minutes')),('Zoe',25,datetime('now','-20 minutes')),('Sam',10,datetime('now','-15 minutes')),('You',20,datetime('now','-10 minutes'))

INSERT INTO logs (who, n, created) WITH RECURSIVE d(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM d WHERE i < 13) SELECT 'You', 20 + (i * 7) % 25 + (14 - i), datetime('now', '-' || (i * 24 + 1) || ' hours') FROM d

card.query: SELECT coalesce(sum(n), 0) AS today FROM logs WHERE who = 'You' AND date(created, 'localtime') = date('now', 'localtime')

changes: A big + button, a streak, a friends leaderboard and a 14-day chart
